title: Marlborough Family Deals
meta_desc: Discover the best family-friendly deals in Marlborough & Blenheim, including activity discounts, campervan hire, and travel insurance from $4.50/day, for a fun and affordable family holiday in NZ's sunniest region
intro: Marlborough is an ideal destination for families, offering a mix of outdoor activities, wildlife cruises, and beautiful scenery. With a budget of $180-$300 per day for a family of four, you can enjoy a range of experiences without breaking the bank. From dolphin watch cruises to exploring the Queen Charlotte Track, there's something for everyone in this stunning region.

sections.heading: Best-Value Activities for Families
sections.body:
Marlborough offers a range of activities that are perfect for families. A dolphin watch cruise is a must-do experience, with prices starting from around $80 per person. The Queen Charlotte Track is also a great option, with short sections that are family-friendly and offer stunning views of the Marlborough Sounds.

For a more relaxing experience, consider a visit to the Picton township and foreshore, or take a trip to the Edwin Fox Maritime Museum. These activities are not only fun but also affordable, making them an excellent choice for families on a budget.
list: Dolphin watch cruise from $80 per person
Queen Charlotte Track - short sections from $20 per person
Edwin Fox Maritime Museum - from $10 per person

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips for Families
sections.body:
To make the most of your family holiday in Marlborough, consider the following money-saving tips. Firstly, book your activities and accommodation in advance to secure the best prices. Secondly, look for package deals that include multiple experiences, as these can often work out cheaper than booking individual activities.

Thirdly, take advantage of free activities such as visiting the Picton foreshore and Waitohi Picton play area, or exploring the Momorangi Bay camping and swimming area. Fourthly, consider self-catering accommodation options, which can be more cost-effective than eating out for every meal. Fifthly, pack a picnic lunch and enjoy it at one of the many scenic spots in the area, rather than buying food from a cafe or restaurant. Lastly, keep an eye on the weather forecast and plan your activities accordingly, as some experiences may be weather-dependent.
list: Book activities and accommodation in advance

sections.heading: When to Book for the Best Prices
sections.body:
To get the best prices for your family holiday in Marlborough, it's essential to book your activities and accommodation at the right time. Generally, the earlier you book, the better the prices will be. Consider booking your holiday during the shoulder season, which typically falls in the months of April to May or September to November.

During this time, prices tend to be lower, and the weather is still mild and pleasant. Additionally, avoid booking during peak season, which usually occurs from December to March, as prices tend to be higher during this period.
